LLNL-TR-2004972 TECHNICAL DATA SHEET – THIOKOL® 5050 Revised: 3/2017 DESCRIPTION BENEFITS Thiokol® 5050 primer is a low viscosity primer used to prime concrete and • Low viscosity formulation penetrates steel surfaces for Thiokol polysulfide sealants. and seals concrete pores • Easy 1:1 volume mixing TYPICAL APPLICATION • Easy to apply • Fast recoat time Thiokol® 5050 Primer @ 700-800 linear ft/unit (concrete) PRIMER – 2-3 mils (steel) RECOMMENDED USES SEALANT Thiokol® polysulfide sealant system • Concrete and steel primer as part of a complete Thiokol® Sealant System PERFORMANCE DATA VOC 0.0 gm/L GENERIC DESCRIPTION: Epoxy Primer VOLUME SOLIDS 65% STANDARD COLORS: STORAGE & INSTALLATION Clear Amber STORAGE ENVIRONMENT Dry area, 65-80ºF PACKAGING: APPLICATION TEMPERATURE, AMBIENT 40-95ºF 0.25-Gallon Unit APPLICATION TEMPERATURE, SUBSTRATE Minimum 5º above dew point MIX RATIO: SHELF LIFE 1 year 1R : 1H POT LIFE, @ 77ºF 3 hours COVERAGE: RECOAT TIME FOR CONCRETE, @ 77ºF min 2 hours / max 36 hours ½” – 960 linear ft/unit RECOAT TIME FOR STEEL, @ 77ºF min 4 hours / max 36 hours 1” – 480 linear ft/unit Material cures more slowly at cooler temperatures, and working time will be substantially reduced at higher 700–800 linear ft/unit (concrete) temperatures. In hot weather, material should be cooled to 65ºF to 80ºF prior to mixing and application to improve workability and avoid shortened pot life. The data shown above reflects typical results based on 1100-1300 linear ft/unit (steel) laboratory testing under controlled conditions. Reasonable variations from the data shown above may result.
